builds.name: To Be, or Not to be Budget
builds.desc:
This build works best with QP, but could work without it.*
The thing about this build is that if you are determined to make Gray the best he can be, you need lots of 5 stars and sp, but if you hate grinding and hate sacrificing 5 stars, you can go with the budget version of this set. +Atk, and -Hp is my Gray, but it can be flexible as long as it isn't -Atk. His weapon could be Brave Sword, or Brave Sword+, either one works. This allows him to double all enemies, and with his high attack, it can be more deadly than other Brave Sword users. His assist is flexible, but I recommend his default assist, or Reposition. His special should be Moonbow, but you can also use something like Bonfire for more damage with more charge. His Passive A is flexible, but my Gray uses Atk +3. Fury 3 also works and increases his bulk. L+D is another option but it reduces his bulk for 2 more attack and 5 more spd. The best b slot skill for this set is Swordbreaker, but it can be 2 or 3 considering the difference is marginal, and people usually don't have extra Abels. Lastly, his c slot skill is flexible, but I recommend Threaten Def 3, as it helps some KOs. Threaten Def 2 is also a budget option. Now this part is where the name comes into play. The max sp cost for this build with BS+, Reposition, Bonfire and/or Moonbow, Fury or L+D, Sword Breaker 3, Threaten Def 3, and Learning Sword Valor 3 for grinding puposes, comes out to A WHOPPING 3210 SP. The lowest sp cost of this build with Brave Sword, Default Swap, Moonbow, Atk +3, Sword breaker 2, Threaten Def 2, and Sword Valor for grinding purposes, comes out to a total of 1725, which is low since if you grind during x2 Sp and have sword valor 3, you get 12 sp per kill. And that's it! ~Justthebo50

builds.name: Mymidon Gray!
builds.desc:
This build has been made to capitalise on Gray's best stat -- his atk, and turn him into a fast myrmidon in stead of units like Ayra or Karla.
Slaying Blade is one of the most important parts of this Gray's kit -- it allows him to take Blue Flame down by a small amount and makes it so that he can synergise with skills like Infantry Pulse to get a very fast charge on his Blue Flame -- Especially with Special Spiral 3 in the mix.
Blue Flame is Gray's special of choice as, with a base of 52 atk on this build, it'll make his damage output incredible after one combat since he'll usually be able to orko several units with this.
Swift Sparrow and DB4 are to further capitalise on his very high atk and Swift Sparrow is there to make sure Gray can double people, with 42 effective speed using the refine from Slaying and the seal.
For a C skill you could run either Atk Wave or supportive specials, depending on what sort of team you're running.
